verdict.rationale: The evidence documents pull-request review and merging, Gitea Actions CI/CD workflows, and permission and access controls. None of it documents branch protection, required status checks, or any way to block a merge until custom quality or compliance checks pass. Actions workflows are a building block that could run checks, but enforcing those checks as merge gates is unevidenced, so this support is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enforce custom quality and compliance merge checks on pull requests
